RRB NTPC 10+2 UG Level 07/2026 Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the short notice for the post of Non Technical Popular Categories NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Level Posts on the official website of RRB. This recruitment has released for 1688 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB NTPC 10+2 UG Level 07/2026 Recruitment 2026 will start from 15 October 2026, & candidate can apply until 13 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Railway RRB NTPC 10+2 UG Level 07/2026 Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 October 2026
  • Last Date : 13 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 November 2026
  • Correction / Modified Form : Notify Later
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
